title: OptimizationProposal
description: Any agent's proposal to change the system. Deliberately narrow so it does not become narration by another name: all four evidence fields are required, the whole thing is capped at 300 tokens, and one proposal per agent per work order. A proposal without run evidence is discarded at intake without reaching the Commission.

proposed_by.description: Agent role. Tracked for proposal precision: approved-and-held / submitted.

observation.description: The inefficiency, with evidence from an actual run — a work-order id, a metric, a verdict field. Not a hypothetical.

evidence_refs.description: Required. Intake discards proposals with none.

change.description: The concrete change. Not 'improve retrieval' — the specific rule, value, prompt edit, or gate check.

expected_effect.description: A falsifiable prediction. If the metric does not move after release, the amendment is auto-reverted and recorded against the proposer.

risk.description: What this could break, and which guardrail it touches.

amendment_class.description: Ordinary: 80% Commission vote. Constitutional: human ratification, Commission vote advisory only. Anything touching separation of duties, Gate 0's authority, the unanimity rule, human checkpoints, security/evidence requirements, the amendment process itself — or the proposer's own budget, tier, or evaluation — is constitutional automatically.

support_count.description: How many agents independently proposed this. Raised support is evidence of a real pattern.

golden_set_delta.description: Mechanically testable proposals are evaluated BEFORE the vote — an eval is far cheaper than ten seats.

abstain.description: Permitted only outside the seat's jurisdiction.

threshold_met.description: approve >= 80% of non-abstaining votes AND approve >= 6 absolute.

jurisdictional_veto.description: C6 (Security) and C10 (Evidence & Process) hold an absolute veto over proposals touching their jurisdiction. A security-weakening optimization does not pass 8-2.

reject_rationales.description: Required on REJECT only; approvals carry no prose.

release.description: Approval is not deployment. The Commission approves the change; the eval proves it works and the monitor can roll it back.
